task: Resource check for CLI scroll isolation

resource_risks.mitigation: The dev server exec session was stopped with Ctrl-C and tcp:3224 had no remaining listener.

resource_risks.description: Playwright browser contexts can leak if the smoke script fails before cleanup.
resource_risks.mitigation: Smoke scripts called browser.close() and completed with exit code 0.

resource_risks.description: Tauri, Cargo, codesign, and hdiutil subprocesses must be awaited during internal packaging.
resource_risks.mitigation: The package exec session was polled until process exit and returned code 0.
evidence: corepack pnpm run desktop:package:internal exited code 0

resource_risks.description: Build and smoke steps create generated snapshots, screenshots, and Tauri bundle artifacts.
resource_risks.mitigation: Generated snapshots were restored to developer mode after packaging; screenshot is retained as a bounded validation artifact; Tauri target artifacts remain under build output paths.
evidence: final corepack pnpm --filter workspace-monitor run collect && check passed
